passives.name: One Blessed By The Moon's Grace
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Reduces Attack of all enemies. This effect cannot be removed. At the start of the turn, inflicts Unbuffable on all enemies for [Buff_T_licence_week_119] turn(s). Right after all attacks, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response. Reduces damage taken from non-Ranger enemies. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Water enemies by 50%. Reduces damage taken from non-Water enemies, and increases damage dealt to them. Increases damage taken from Water enemies, and reduces damage dealt to them.

buffs.summary: +15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
